body.name: Planted selector normalized-quadratic promise languages
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{sel}}=\{Q:z_Q\in\operatorname{Sol}(Q),\ (z_Q)_{s_Q}=0,\text{ and }x_{s_Q}\in\{0,1\}\text{ for every }x\in\operatorname{Sol}(Q)\}\). The uncomplemented language is \(\mathsf{SEL\mbox{-}PNQF}=\{Q\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{sel}}:\exists x\in\operatorname{Sol}(Q)\text{ with }x_{s_Q}=1\}\). Its promise complement is \(\mathsf{coSEL\mbox{-}PNQF}=\{Q\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{sel}}:\forall x\in\operatorname{Sol}(Q),\ x_{s_Q}=0\}\). Thus, within the promise, the YES predicate of the uncomplemented language is existence of a selector-one solution and its NO predicate is universal selector zero; the complemented language swaps these YES and NO labels. Strings outside \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{sel}}\) are outside both promise problems.
